column_description: BIGSERIAL. Auto-generated unique identifier for moderation and compliance record. PK = ModerationAndCompliance(Mod_Reg).
TEXT. Reference to interaction record for moderation context. FK to Interactions.
BIGINT. Reference to social community record for moderation analysis. FK to SocialCommunity.
SMALLINT. Number of reports filed against this fan's content or behavior.
SMALLINT. Number of warnings issued to this fan for policy violations.
TEXT. History of policy violations committed by the fan. **NULL means no violation history recorded or clean conduct record.**
TEXT. Current moderation status and any active restrictions on the account.
TEXT. Content compliance rating and adherence to platform guidelines.
TEXT. Age verification status for access to age-restricted content.
TEXT. Payment method verification status. **NULL means payment verification not completed or not required for current membership tier.**
TEXT. Identity verification status for enhanced security features. **NULL means identity verification not completed or not required for current account type.**
